title: 技術問題
description: 排除技術問題的溝通用語

sentences.en: The printer is not working again.
sentences.zh: 印表機又不能用了。

sentences.en: The app keeps crashing every time I open it.
sentences.zh: 每次我打開這個 App 它就當掉。

sentences.en: I think there's a bug in the system.
sentences.zh: 我覺得系統有一個 bug。

sentences.en: I got an error message when I tried to save.
sentences.zh: 我嘗試儲存時出現了一個錯誤訊息。

sentences.en: Have you tried restarting the device?
sentences.zh: 你有試過重新啟動裝置嗎？

sentences.en: I called technical support for help.
sentences.zh: 我打電話給技術支援求助了。

sentences.en: The screen is frozen and I can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 螢幕當住了，我什麼都做不了。

sentences.en: It says 'access denied' when I try to open it.
sentences.zh: 我嘗試打開時顯示「拒絕存取」。

sentences.en: The website is down right now.
sentences.zh: 這個網站現在掛了。

sentences.en: I keep getting a 'connection timed out' error.
sentences.zh: 我一直收到「連線逾時」的錯誤。

sentences.en: The update broke something on my computer.
sentences.zh: 更新弄壞了我電腦上的一些東西。

sentences.en: Can you check if the cable is plugged in properly?
sentences.zh: 你可以看看線有沒有插好嗎？

sentences.en: The audio is not working during the video call.
sentences.zh: 視訊通話時音訊不能用。

sentences.en: I accidentally clicked on a phishing link.
sentences.zh: 我不小心點了一個釣魚連結。

sentences.en: My email won't send; it keeps showing an error.
sentences.zh: 我的郵件寄不出去，一直顯示錯誤。

sentences.en: The file won't open because it's corrupted.
sentences.zh: 這個檔案打不開，因為它損壞了。

sentences.en: I need to clear the browser cache.
sentences.zh: 我需要清除瀏覽器快取。

sentences.en: There's no sound coming from the speakers.
sentences.zh: 喇叭沒有發出聲音。

sentences.en: The system keeps asking me to update, but it fails every time.
sentences.zh: 系統一直叫我更新，但每次都失敗。

sentences.en: I submitted a ticket to the IT department.
sentences.zh: 我向 IT 部門提交了一張工單。

sentences.en: My webcam is not being detected.
sentences.zh: 我的視訊鏡頭偵測不到。

sentences.en: The software is not compatible with my operating system.
sentences.zh: 這個軟體跟我的作業系統不相容。

sentences.en: I ran a virus scan but nothing was found.
sentences.zh: 我掃了毒但什麼都沒發現。

sentences.en: The program stopped responding.
sentences.zh: 這個程式停止回應了。

sentences.en: I had to force quit the application.
sentences.zh: 我不得不強制關閉應用程式。

sentences.en: It worked fine yesterday, but now it won't start.
sentences.zh: 昨天還好好的，現在卻啟動不了。

sentences.en: Can you walk me through the troubleshooting steps?
sentences.zh: 你可以帶我一步步排除問題嗎？

sentences.en: I think the driver needs to be reinstalled.
sentences.zh: 我覺得驅動程式需要重新安裝。

sentences.en: The power button is not responding.
sentences.zh: 電源按鈕沒有反應。

sentences.en: I restored the system to a previous backup.
sentences.zh: 我把系統還原到之前的備份了。
